what_developers_prioritize: Performance optimization over data validation (REST v2 issues persist)
Feature development over edge case handling (segment lifecycle)
Index functionality over data safety (compaction errors)
blindspot_indicators: REST v2 API data type serialization - 8 issues in corpus
Snapshot isolation broken during concurrent operations - 7 issues
Memory admission control bypassed - 6 OOM issues
RBAC privilege annotations incomplete - 5 security issues
Concurrent operation edge cases - 12 deadlock/hang issues
REST v2 and gRPC divergent validation: REST v2 accepting values the gRPC path rejects (maintainers treat cross-channel inconsistency as a defect and fix it)

Documentation-behavior consistency: when official documentation claims a behavior or capability that the server does not exhibit (documented X, actual behavior is not-X), this is a consistency defect - maintainers' repeated disposition is to fix it, usually by correcting the docs to match verified behavior (docs PRs 3402, 3513/3514; issue 46494 closed as fixed). 'The behavior looks reasonable on its own' does not neutralize a documented claim that contradicts it

areas_with_repeated_issues.pattern: State machine violations during lifecycle transitions
Deadlocks and hangs in concurrent DML/DQL

Doc-implementation inconsistency falling in these categories should be treated as acknowledged defect direction.
